title: Store Files Outside Business Central Using External File Accounts (BC 2025 Wave 1)

chapters.title: Creating External File Accounts in Business Central
Setting Up New Blob Storage Account
Storage Browser Navigation and File Management

features.name: External File Storage Module
features.description: A new module in Business Central 2025 Wave 1 that allows management of external files more easily through a unified API. Includes extensions for Azure Blob Service, File Service, and SharePoint connectors.
caveats: SharePoint connector requires a SharePoint server or web application to be set up
Requires installation of external file storage extensions

features.name: Azure Blob Service Integration
features.description: An extension that manages containers in Azure Blob Service, allowing external file storage and retrieval through Business Central external file accounts.

features.name: Azure File Service Integration
features.description: An extension that manages file shares in Azure File Service, enabling file share storage and management through Business Central external file accounts.

features.name: External File Accounts Setup
features.description: A wizard-based setup interface in Business Central that allows creation and configuration of external file accounts to connect to Azure storage services using shared keys and connection details.
caveats: Requires external file storage extensions to be installed
Requires Azure storage account and access keys

features.name: Storage Browser Interface
features.description: A user interface within Business Central that displays contents of external storage accounts, allows directory navigation, file upload, and folder creation in Azure containers and file shares.
caveats: No drag and drop functionality - requires click to upload
